description: The rear single storey extension of the swimming pool outbuilding, alongside alterations to an existing garage outbuilding. The proposal also includes replacement gates and the erection of hardstanding. (Retrospective)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans (as set out on page one of this decision notice).
For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 the extension to the swimming pool outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling house and not for any trade or business nor as living accommodation.
To restrict the use to one compatible with a residential area.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, no window or other opening (other than those shown on the submitted and approved plan,) shall be formed in the flank wall(s) of the building(s) hereby permitted, unless specific permission under the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 has first been sought and obtained in writing from the Local Planning Authority.
In order to ensure a satisfactory development that will not result in any loss of privacy or damage to the environment of neighbouring properties which exist or may be proposed in the future.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
In the interests of the amenity of the occupiers of neighbouring dwelling.

All hard surfaces hereby approved as part of the development (including any sub-base) shall be made of porous materials or provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hard surface to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the application site.
In order to ensure no water run-off from the hard surface which would contribute to risk of flooding.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, improvements required to make the proposal acceptable were negotiated with Mr Peacock (Agent) by phone and e-mail. The revisions involved revising the plan number so there were no duplication and for clarity. The amendments were subsequently submitted on 06/07/26, 04/08/26 & 21/09/26.

The applicant should note that the erection of the garden ponds with the hardstanding around it and any hardstanding not shown on drawing D01 received on 21st September 2026 does not form part of this application. In addition, it should be noted that the storage & garage to south west side of the dwelling which should have been demolished to make way for the new dwelling does not form part of this application either. These other elements are still under investigation by Planning Enforcement.
